targets.query:
import "date"

// Use a whole-day boundary so expired raw data never leaves a partial day.
cutover = date.add(d: 1d, to: date.truncate(t: date.sub(d: 30d, from: now()), unit: 1d))
raw = from(bucket: "room_telemetry")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_environment" and r._field == "temperature_c")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= cutover)
daily = from(bucket: "room_telemetry_daily")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_environment" and r._field == "temperature_c_mean")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time < cutover)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "temperature_c"}))
union(tables: [daily, raw])
    |> group(columns: ["device_id", "_field"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Original readings for the most recent fully retained UTC days; daily means for older history. Daily minimum, maximum, and sample count are also stored in room_telemetry_daily. A daily point is timestamped at 00:00 UTC and represents that UTC day.
